caption:
How to do weekly invoicing and payment reminders with AI (2 copy-paste prompts)

Keep a one-line job log during the week. On Friday, run 2 prompts.

Prompt 1:
"Here's my job log for the week. Group it by client. For each client: invoice lines (date, job, amount), the total, and a 3-line friendly email to send with the invoice. Payment due in [X] days. Don't change any amounts. Log: [PASTE]"

Prompt 2:
"These invoices are unpaid: [CLIENT, INVOICE NO., AMOUNT, DAYS LATE]. Write a short reminder for each. Under 7 days: friendly nudge. 8 to 21: polite but clear. Over 21: firm, ask for a payment date. No guilt-tripping."

In our invented example, a one-person gardening service, Friday admin went from about 2 hours to about 20 minutes. Yours depends on how many jobs you do. Check every amount before sending, and keep addresses and bank details out of the chat.
